recipe.visualDefinition: A full-body portrait of a bearded man in a dark suit standing against a textured, light-blue studio backdrop. He holds a trumpet vertically, topped with a large puff of pink cotton candy. The composition is split, with the subject on the left and a dense block of centered, black sans-serif typography on the right, accented by a white script title.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject pointing towards the central prop (trumpet/candy)
Contrast between the dark suit and the light, textured background
Balance between the heavy vertical text block and the human figure
Color harmony between the pink prop and the cool blue environment
coreInvariants: Textured, painterly blue background with subtle vignetting
Whimsical prop integration with a musical instrument
Full-body standing pose with direct eye contact

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject occupies the left third of the frame, full-body, approximately 70% of the vertical height.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The pink cotton candy at the center-left acts as the primary focal point due to its color and central placement.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eye starts at the subject's face, follows his pointing finger to the cotton candy, then moves right to the large display typography.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant negative space in the upper corners and around the text block to maintain a clean, mid-century look.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Light cyan/blue with a paper-like texture for the background.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Solid black for the primary typography and the subject's suit.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Soft pastel pink for the cotton candy and white for the script lettering.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value, low saturation background against low value, high contrast foreground elements.

letterConstructionRules: Heavy weight for primary display names
Uniform stroke width in the sans-serif blocks
characterSpecificRedesigns: Script title features thin, monolinear strokes with large, looping ascenders and descenders
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast pairing of a heavy, rigid sans-serif with a delicate, fluid monoline script.
graphicDevices: Centered alignment for all text elements

preserve: Uppercase sans-serif for the main name

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the weight and grotesque feel of the primary name.
Captures the airy, mid-century script aesthetic.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A full-body studio photograph of a man in a dark suit holding a trumpet with pink cotton candy on top, set against a textured light blue background with a subtle vignette.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add centered typography on the right side using a heavy black sans-serif for the main name and a delicate white script for the title above the prop.

verificationChecks: Is the text centered on the right half of the image?
Is the background texture visible and not a flat color?
Is the cotton candy prop clearly pink and fluffy?
Is the script font thin and white?

mustRedesign: Specific brand logos in the corners
Original artist name and album titles
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the man is pointing at the prop.
Verify the text block is solid black and sharp.
Check that the script font does not overlap the man's face.
Confirm the background has a paper-like grain texture.
recipe.reuseFormula: Subject on left + Prop in center + Heavy centered sans-serif on right + Textured monochromatic backdrop.
